title: Revised Fee Structure of Hostels of the University of Jammu for the year 2025-26 onwards

source.name: University of Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir

text:
KEY LINES:
revised fee structure of Hostels of the University of Jammu for the year
Maintenance Fee Rs. 950/- per academic year

FULL TEXT:
It is hereby notified for the information of all concerned that the
revised fee structure of Hostels of the University of Jammu for the year
2025-26, shall be as under:
Particulars
Room Rent
Rent for one seat Rs. 1070/- per academic year
Rs. 1290/- per academic year
Miscellaneous Charges Rs. 400/- per academic year
Maintenance Fee Rs. 950/- per academic year
Other Charses
Hostel Security
Mess Security
General breakage charges Rs. 1 100/- per academic year
Hostel Infrastructure
Development Fund
Rs. 900/- per academic year
Generator Maintenance &
Fuel Charges
Rs. 1250/- per academic year
Copy for information to:-
1. Special Secretary to the Vice-Chancellor, University of Jammu for the kind information of the
Hon;ble Vice-Chancellor please
2. Sr. P.A. to the Dean Academic Affairs
3. Sr. P.A. to the Registrar
4. Provost Hostels (Boys/Girls) _/)
S. Dean Students Welfare '-'
6. Finance Officer/Director, Centre for ITES&M
Z. Joint Registrar, Academie Affairs/Finance
B. Wardens of all University Hostels
9. Guard File
